dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……はぁ〜、美味しいね♪」
dialogues.en: "...Ahh, this is so good~"
dialogues.text: "...Ahh, this is so good~"

dialogues.jp:
ツルツル、と食べるのが遅いので伸びかけてい
るラーメンを、音夢が極楽極楽といった調子で
すする。
dialogues.en: Slowly savouring her ramen, Nemu was in paradise.
dialogues.text: Slowly savouring her ramen, Nemu was in paradise.

dialogues.jp: 「美味いけどさ、そろそろ中華も飽きてきたな」
dialogues.en: "As good as it is, I'm getting sick of Chinese food."
dialogues.text: "As good as it is, I'm getting sick of Chinese food."

dialogues.jp:
チャーハンの残りをかきこみながら、ため息を
つく。
dialogues.en:
Poking the remnants of my Chinese-style fried rice with my
work, I let out a little sigh.
dialogues.text:
Poking the remnants of my Chinese-style fried rice with my
work, I let out a little sigh.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうだねぇ。後はピザ、｛てんやもの／店屋物｝、お弁当の配
　達と……ローテーションだとなんだっけ？」
dialogues.en:
"I suppose. There's still pizza, take-out, dinner
delivery... how do yo you want to rotate it?"
dialogues.text:
"I suppose. There's still pizza, take-out, dinner
delivery... how do yo you want to rotate it?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いや、俺が言っているのは、そろそろこの状
　態から脱しようということだ」
dialogues.en:
"No, what I meant was having something different from that
usual menu..."
dialogues.text:
"No, what I meant was having something different from that
usual menu..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、兄さんが料理作ってよ」
dialogues.en: "If that's the case, have fun cooking dinner."
dialogues.text: "If that's the case, have fun cooking dinner."

dialogues.jp:
ジト目で｛にら／睨｝みながらも、俺に食後のお茶をだし
てくれる。
dialogues.en:
I nearly spit out my after-meal tea, under the scowling gaze
of Nemu.
dialogues.text:
I nearly spit out my after-meal tea, under the scowling gaze
of Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
「俺が料理を作ると、材料費が高いわりに不味
　いって文句言うじゃねぇか」
dialogues.en:
"If you want me to cook, then don't complain about the
inedibility and cost of ingredients from the result."
dialogues.text:
"If you want me to cook, then don't complain about the
inedibility and cost of ingredients from the result."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「お金かけすぎなんだもん……だから、私が作
　るって♪」
dialogues.en:
"We don't have much money left... so leave the cooking to
me~"
dialogues.text:
"We don't have much money left... so leave the cooking to
me~"

dialogues.jp: 音夢が自分の鼻を指差す。
dialogues.en: Nemu pointed to herself, or more accurately, her nose.
dialogues.text: Nemu pointed to herself, or more accurately, her nose.

dialogues.jp:
「……とりあえず、テストが終わってからにし
　よう」
dialogues.en: "....In any case, that can wait till after the tests."
dialogues.text: "....In any case, that can wait till after the tests."

dialogues.jp:
あんな、暗殺者が毒として通販させてくれと要
望してきそうな料理が食えるか。
dialogues.en:
I'd rather pay an assassin to poison my food than taste her
cooking.
dialogues.text:
I'd rather pay an assassin to poison my food than taste her
cooking.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへ。楽しみにしててね♪」
dialogues.en: "Eheheh, I'd look forward to it~"
dialogues.text: "Eheheh, I'd look forward to it~"

dialogues.jp:
計算か訓練でもしてるのか、おそろしく見事な
角度で首をかしげる。
dialogues.en:
She tilted her head to the side in what looked like an
impossible angle.
dialogues.text:
She tilted her head to the side in what looked like an
impossible angle.

dialogues.jp: とりあえず、それまでに胃を鍛えておこう……。
dialogues.en:
Both ways, I'd have to start preparing my stomach now for
the torture to come...
dialogues.text:
Both ways, I'd have to start preparing my stomach now for
the torture to come...

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、コンビニが一番レパートリーが豊富
　なのも、考えどころだよな……」
dialogues.en:
"You know, now that I think about it, convenience store food
really does have a large selection..."
dialogues.text:
"You know, now that I think about it, convenience store food
really does have a large selection..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ご馳走様でした」
dialogues.en: "I'm done."
dialogues.text: "I'm done."

dialogues.jp: 箸をおいてマイペースな音夢が手を合わせる。
dialogues.en: Completely ignoring me, Nemu reached for my chopsticks.
dialogues.text: Completely ignoring me, Nemu reached for my chopsticks.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「食器、私が片付けるから置いといていいよ」
dialogues.en: "I'd handle the washing up."
dialogues.text: "I'd handle the washing up."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ん。サンキュ」
dialogues.en: "Okay, thanks."
dialogues.text: "Okay, thanks."

dialogues.jp:
ふぅ、と一息ついてから、特に見たいテレビも
ないし、２階の自室へと戻る。
dialogues.en:
With a little sigh, and with nothing particular to watch on
TV, I went to my room on the second floor.
dialogues.text:
With a little sigh, and with nothing particular to watch on
TV, I went to my room on the second floor.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はよ〜ん♪」
dialogues.en: "Heya♪"
dialogues.text: "Heya♪"

dialogues.jp: ――バタン！
dialogues.en: --Bang!
dialogues.text: --Bang!

dialogues.jp: 「音夢っ！　音夢っ！」
dialogues.en: "Nemu! Nemu!"
dialogues.text: "Nemu! Nemu!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なに慌ててるの？　ゴキブリでも出た？」
dialogues.en: "What's the fuss about? Did you see a cockroach?"
dialogues.text: "What's the fuss about? Did you see a cockroach?"

dialogues.jp: ひょっこり、と台所から音夢が顔をだす。
dialogues.en: Nemu's face came peeking out from the kitchen.
dialogues.text: Nemu's face came peeking out from the kitchen.

dialogues.jp: 「節分の豆は残っているか！？」
dialogues.en: "Did we leave any beans from Bean Throwing Night?!"
dialogues.text: "Did we leave any beans from Bean Throwing Night?!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もしくは、これは夢か？」
dialogues.en: "Or maybe, is this a dream?"
dialogues.text: "Or maybe, is this a dream?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、じゃあいい！」
dialogues.en: "No, nevermind!"
dialogues.text: "No, nevermind!"

dialogues.jp: 階段を駆け上がる。
dialogues.en: I ran back up the stairs.
dialogues.text: I ran back up the stairs.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なにやってる？」
dialogues.en: "Whatcha doing?"
dialogues.text: "Whatcha doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……それは俺の台詞だ」
dialogues.en: "...That's my line."
dialogues.text: "...That's my line."

dialogues.jp:
俺のベッドの上に座っていたさくらの｛えりくび／襟首｝をつ
まんで、机の前の座布団におろす。
dialogues.en:
I picked Sakura up from my bed, and put her on one of the
spare cushions lying around.
dialogues.text:
I picked Sakura up from my bed, and put her on one of the
spare cushions lying around.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ」
dialogues.en: "Unya!"
dialogues.text: "Unya!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……どこから不法侵入したんだお前は？」
dialogues.en: "Haa... where on earth did you come in here from?"
dialogues.text: "Haa... where on earth did you come in here from?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「普通に入ってきたよぉ」
dialogues.en: "I entered normally!"
dialogues.text: "I entered normally!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「玄関の鍵でも開いてたのか？」
dialogues.en: "Through the front door, using a key?"
dialogues.text: "Through the front door, using a key?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「桜の木を伝ってあそこの窓から。ちゃんとノッ
　クもしたよ？」
dialogues.en:
"By climbing up the sakura tree and through your window.
Didn't you hear me knock?"
dialogues.text:
"By climbing up the sakura tree and through your window.
Didn't you hear me knock?"

dialogues.jp: さくらがベッド上の窓を指差す。
dialogues.en: Sakura pointed to the window just above the bed.
dialogues.text: Sakura pointed to the window just above the bed.

dialogues.jp:
「……それは全世界どこでも不法侵入だと思う
　ぞ」
dialogues.en: "...No one in the world would consider that normal."
dialogues.text: "...No one in the world would consider that normal."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃんが良いって言ったんだよ」
dialogues.en: "You said it would be fine before!"
dialogues.text: "You said it would be fine before!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「は？　……あぁ、それは子供のころの話だろ
　うが」
dialogues.en: "Huh? ...Aah, that was back when we were kids."
dialogues.text: "Huh? ...Aah, that was back when we were kids."

dialogues.jp: 椅子に腰掛けてため息をつく。
dialogues.en: I fell back into a chair with a sigh.
dialogues.text: I fell back into a chair with a sigh.

dialogues.jp:
確かに、さくらの家の庭から俺の部屋の窓まで
桜の枝が伸びていて、そこからこいつが遊びに
来るのを容認していた気もする。
dialogues.en:
Sakura used to climb up the tree near her house to get into
my room to play, as it stretched all the way to my window.
dialogues.text:
Sakura used to climb up the tree near her house to get into
my room to play, as it stretched all the way to my window.

dialogues.jp:
そう、夜中までこっそりと遊んでいたこともあっ
たっけ……。
dialogues.en: That's right, we used to play well into the night...
dialogues.text: That's right, we used to play well into the night...

dialogues.jp:
「だが、この年になって、異性の部屋にそう気
　軽に入ってくるのは色々とまずいだろう」
dialogues.en:
"But, at this age, going into a male's room so casually,
there's a lot of things wrong with that."
dialogues.text:
"But, at this age, going into a male's room so casually,
there's a lot of things wrong with that."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あっ、えへへへ。ちゃんとレディーとして見
　てくれてるんだね」
dialogues.en: "Ah, ehehe. You look ready for that anyway."
dialogues.text: "Ah, ehehe. You look ready for that anyway."

dialogues.jp:
スカートの｛すそ／裾｝を軽く持ち上げて、さくらが微笑
む。
dialogues.en:
Sakura gave her best impression of a sultry smile, and
started lifting the hem of her skirt.
dialogues.text:
Sakura gave her best impression of a sultry smile, and
started lifting the hem of her skirt.

dialogues.jp: 「違う、礼儀の問題だ」
dialogues.en: "NO! It's a problem of manners!"
dialogues.text: "NO! It's a problem of manners!"

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく持ち上げられた裾に目がいってしま
い、慌てて首を振る。
dialogues.en:
Trying not to look, I shook my head from side to side
vigourously.
dialogues.text:
Trying not to look, I shook my head from side to side
vigourously.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたの？　なんだか顔が赤いよ？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong? Why's your face so red?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong? Why's your face so red?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……レディがそういうことをするなよ」
dialogues.en: "...Because of all your talk about being "ready"."
dialogues.text: "...Because of all your talk about being "ready"."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫だよブルマはいてるもん。見る？」
dialogues.en:
"Psh, I'm wearing bloomers underneath after all. Want to
see?"
dialogues.text:
"Psh, I'm wearing bloomers underneath after all. Want to
see?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「見たいわけないだろうが……」
dialogues.en: "You say that so easily..."
dialogues.text: "You say that so easily..."

dialogues.jp:
なんだか青い空を見上げる気分で、爽やかに
――心で涙を流しながら顔をそむける。
dialogues.en:
The feeling of gazing at the blue sky is so invigorating...
It washes away the tears of the heart.
dialogues.text:
The feeling of gazing at the blue sky is so invigorating...
It washes away the tears of the heart.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あ〜あ、これで同じクラスだったら最高だっ
　たのになぁ」
dialogues.en:
"Aaaah, it would've been so much better if we were in the
same class..."
dialogues.text:
"Aaaah, it would've been so much better if we were in the
same class..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……そんな恐ろしいことを平然と言うな」
dialogues.en: "...Don't say such terrifying things so easily."
dialogues.text: "...Don't say such terrifying things so easily."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？　恐ろしい？」
dialogues.en: "Unya? Terrifying?"
dialogues.text: "Unya? Terrifying?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「気にするな。ともかく、一体お前は何をしに
　来たんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Don't mind me. Anyway, what did you come here for?"
dialogues.text: "Don't mind me. Anyway, what did you come here for?"

dialogues.jp: あんなとこから、と夜桜が浮かぶ窓を示す。
dialogues.en: Some night-viewing of sakura trees, maybe?
dialogues.text: Some night-viewing of sakura trees, maybe?

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうそう、帰ってきた挨拶だよ！」
dialogues.en: "I'm waiting for your "welcome back"!"
dialogues.text: "I'm waiting for your "welcome back"!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「学校でさんざんっぱら騒いだだろうが……」
dialogues.en: "You already made so much fuss about it in school..."
dialogues.text: "You already made so much fuss about it in school..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ぶぅ！　まだ、ちゃんと引越しの挨拶もして
　なかったんだも〜ん」
dialogues.en:
"Boo! So you still don't want to welcome back someone who
moved away so long ago!"
dialogues.text:
"Boo! So you still don't want to welcome back someone who
moved away so long ago!"

dialogues.jp:
と、さくらは急に眉根をよせると、左膝をつい
て右手の平を俺に向ける。
dialogues.en:
Sakura slapped her left knee with her right palm in disgust,
her eyebrows narrowing.
dialogues.text:
Sakura slapped her left knee with her right palm in disgust,
her eyebrows narrowing.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お控えなすって！　手前、遠くアメリカから
　やって参りました芳乃さくらという｛ふつつか／不束｝な者
　です」
dialogues.en:
"You listen! Yoshino Sakura, returning from faraway America,
has finally come back to the unwashed masses!"
dialogues.text:
"You listen! Yoshino Sakura, returning from faraway America,
has finally come back to the unwashed masses!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「これから先、同じ組で肩を寄せ合う｛はらから／同胞｝とし
　て、ケジメをつけさせて頂きたく参りました」
dialogues.en:
"From now on, I will mingle shoulder-to-shoulder with the
underpriveleged, and eventually take my rightful position at
the top of this mess!"
dialogues.text:
"From now on, I will mingle shoulder-to-shoulder with the
underpriveleged, and eventually take my rightful position at
the top of this mess!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Hah?"
dialogues.text: "Hah?"

dialogues.jp: 組……って自治体のことか？
dialogues.en: Class... a municipality, she means?
dialogues.text: Class... a municipality, she means?

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「って、引越しそばを持ってこなきゃ、やっぱ
　り締まらないね♪」
dialogues.en:
"Basically, don't shut your door to someone who's just moved
in next to you♪"
dialogues.text:
"Basically, don't shut your door to someone who's just moved
in next to you♪"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そういう問題じゃねぇだろうが」
dialogues.en: "I don't see why that's a problem."
dialogues.text: "I don't see why that's a problem."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そんなことないよ〜。義理と人情｛はかり／秤｝にかけ
　りゃ、義理が勝つのがこの世の掟――って
　言うでしょ♪」
dialogues.en:
"Don't say that~ When duty and personal feelings battle it
out, that duty should win is one of the world's laws-- isn't
it?"
dialogues.text:
"Don't say that~ When duty and personal feelings battle it
out, that duty should win is one of the world's laws-- isn't
it?"

dialogues.jp: 頭がクラクラする。
dialogues.en: I started getting dizzy.
dialogues.text: I started getting dizzy.

dialogues.jp: 「お前……ちょっと日本の名物を言ってみろ」
dialogues.en: "You... name some famous Japanese things."
dialogues.text: "You... name some famous Japanese things."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なに？　そんなの根っからの日本人であるボ
　クには愚問だよ！」
dialogues.en:
"What? Are you questioning my Japanese nationality? How
foolish!"
dialogues.text:
"What? Are you questioning my Japanese nationality? How
foolish!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いや、いいから」
dialogues.en: "No, just do it."
dialogues.text: "No, just do it."

dialogues.jp: どん、と胸を叩くさくらに突っ込む。
dialogues.en: Sakura beat her chest in confidence.
dialogues.text: Sakura beat her chest in confidence.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「スシ、テンプーラ、フジヤマ〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Sushi, Tempura, Fujiyama~♪"
dialogues.text: "Sushi, Tempura, Fujiyama~♪"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「日本なめてんのかてめぇ……」
dialogues.en: "You're making fun of Japan, arenn't you..."
dialogues.text: "You're making fun of Japan, arenn't you..."

dialogues.jp:
細かく指摘するのも面倒で、勝手にしてくれと、
ため息をつく。
dialogues.en: I point a half-hearted finger at her as I sighed.
dialogues.text: I point a half-hearted finger at her as I sighed.

dialogues.jp:
子供の頃から勘違いした任侠道を貫いていたや
つだが、海外に行って余計な拍車がかかったら
しい。
dialogues.en:
From childhood, she had taken the path of no return, and her
move overseas just further established the fact.
dialogues.text:
From childhood, she had taken the path of no return, and her
move overseas just further established the fact.

dialogues.jp:
スシ、テンプーラ、フジヤマ……まさに、日本
を勘違いしたアメリカ人状態。
dialogues.en:
Sushi, Tempura, Fujiyama... the transition from Japanese to
American appears to have been complete.
dialogues.text:
Sushi, Tempura, Fujiyama... the transition from Japanese to
American appears to have been complete.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……用件はそれだけか？」
dialogues.en: "Haah... Is that all you've got to say?"
dialogues.text: "Haah... Is that all you've got to say?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん、そだね。とりあえずこれからも宜し
　くお願いしますと言うことで」
dialogues.en:
"Mmm, I guess. Anyways, I wanted to say, from now on, let's
be good neighbours!"
dialogues.text:
"Mmm, I guess. Anyways, I wanted to say, from now on, let's
be good neighbours!"

dialogues.jp:
ちょん、とクッションに正座しなおして、さく
らが三つ指をつく。
dialogues.en: Still sitting on her cushion, she stuck out three fingers.
dialogues.text: Still sitting on her cushion, she stuck out three fingers.

dialogues.jp: 「それだけでいいんだよ。後は……」
dialogues.en: "Of course. As long as from now on..."
dialogues.text: "Of course. As long as from now on..."

dialogues.jp:
後は玄関から入ってきて、片膝つかないで、普
通に挨拶出来れば問題ないのだろう。
dialogues.en:
From now on, you knock on the door and enter through the
hallway, just like a normal person.
dialogues.text:
From now on, you knock on the door and enter through the
hallway, just like a normal person.

dialogues.jp: ……全然ダメじゃん。
dialogues.en: .....Not like she'd listen, though.
dialogues.text: .....Not like she'd listen, though.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「えへへへ。そうそうお兄ちゃん、今でもあそ
　この鍵を直さないでいてくれたんだね」
dialogues.en:
"Eheheh, that's right, you still haven't fixed the key for
that."
dialogues.text:
"Eheheh, that's right, you still haven't fixed the key for
that."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あの窓、６年前から鍵が壊れっぱなし」
dialogues.en: "They key for that window, it broke 6 years ago, remember?"
dialogues.text: "They key for that window, it broke 6 years ago, remember?"

dialogues.jp: さっきの俺のように、さくらが窓を指差す。
dialogues.en: Grabbing my attention again, Sakura pointed to the window.
dialogues.text: Grabbing my attention again, Sakura pointed to the window.

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、音夢が無用心だから何度も直そう
と言っていた気がしたが、なんでか直してなかっ
たな。
dialogues.en:
Now that she's said that, Nemu's been insecure about that
and always bothering me to fix that window...
dialogues.text:
Now that she's said that, Nemu's been insecure about that
and always bothering me to fix that window...

dialogues.jp:
ぼぅ、と見つめて何でもないように首をめぐら
す。
dialogues.en: Although, the way I look at it, that's no problem at all.
dialogues.text: Although, the way I look at it, that's no problem at all.

dialogues.jp: 「……面倒だっただけだろ」
dialogues.en: "...That's because it's troublesome to do so."
dialogues.text: "...That's because it's troublesome to do so."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「にゃはは、そういうことにしておいてあげる
　よ」
dialogues.en: "Nyahaha, I'm glad to hear that!"
dialogues.text: "Nyahaha, I'm glad to hear that!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「勝手にしろ」
dialogues.en: "Because it's convenient for you."
dialogues.text: "Because it's convenient for you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うん。勝手にするよ。ボクは勝手に遊びにく
　るから……」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, very convenient. Whenever I want to hang out with
you..."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, very convenient. Whenever I want to hang out with
you..."

dialogues.jp:
立ち上がって窓を開け、さくらが静かな笑みを
たたえて振り返った。
dialogues.en:
Sakura stood up and opened the window, then turned her head
around and giggled slightly.
dialogues.text:
Sakura stood up and opened the window, then turned her head
around and giggled slightly.

dialogues.jp:
冷たい風が吹き込んでくるのに、桜の香りをの
せたそれは――悪くない。
dialogues.en:
The cold air blew through, and the scent of sakuras could be
smelt; not a bad feeling at all.
dialogues.text:
The cold air blew through, and the scent of sakuras could be
smelt; not a bad feeling at all.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ね、今でもアレ出来る？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, can you still make that come out?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, can you still make that come out?"

dialogues.jp: さくらがニパニパと手を閉じたり開いたり。
dialogues.en:
Sakura stuck out her palm, then opened and closed it a few
times.
dialogues.text:
Sakura stuck out her palm, then opened and closed it a few
times.

dialogues.jp: 「これか？」
dialogues.en: "You mean this?"
dialogues.text: "You mean this?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は手を軽く握り締めて、適当な和菓子――饅
頭を思い浮かべる。
dialogues.en:
I closed my hand up into a fist, and pictured an appropriate
wagashi--a manjuu, in my head.
dialogues.text:
I closed my hand up into a fist, and pictured an appropriate
wagashi--a manjuu, in my head.

dialogues.jp:
そうすると、なにもなかったはずの手の平に重
さが生まれる。
dialogues.en: Soon enough, my hand started getting a lot heavier.
dialogues.text: Soon enough, my hand started getting a lot heavier.

dialogues.jp:
――夢を見ることと合わせて俺が持つ、
　　無から和菓子を生み出す不思議な力――
dialogues.en:
--As well as the power to see into dreams, the strange power
to create wagashis--
dialogues.text:
--As well as the power to see into dreams, the strange power
to create wagashis--

dialogues.jp: まるっきり変態的なメルヘンだ。
dialogues.en: It really does sound like some strange fairytale.
dialogues.text: It really does sound like some strange fairytale.

dialogues.jp:
あんまりにも馬鹿らしいので、音夢にも秘密に
しているのだが、さくらだけはこの力のことを
知っていた。
dialogues.en:
It's something that sounds so stupid that only Nemu, and of
course Sakura, knows about it.
dialogues.text:
It's something that sounds so stupid that only Nemu, and of
course Sakura, knows about it.

dialogues.jp: 「ほら。あんこ多めだ」
dialogues.en: "Lots of red bean in this one. Catch!"
dialogues.text: "Lots of red bean in this one. Catch!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「わっ、とと」
dialogues.en: "Wa, wah!"
dialogues.text: "Wa, wah!"

dialogues.jp:
空中に放った饅頭を、慌ててさくらがキャッチ
する。
dialogues.en:
I threw the manjuu in the air, and Sakura, after a bout of
confusion, managed to hold onto it.
dialogues.text:
I threw the manjuu in the air, and Sakura, after a bout of
confusion, managed to hold onto it.

dialogues.jp: 「それ食ったら、寝る前にちゃんと歯を磨けよ」
dialogues.en:
"You better remember to brush your teeth after you eat
that."
dialogues.text:
"You better remember to brush your teeth after you eat
that."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「もう子供じゃないですよ〜だ！」
dialogues.en: "I'm not a kid anymore~~!"
dialogues.text: "I'm not a kid anymore~~!"

dialogues.jp:
べ〜、と舌をだして、まるっきり子供の仕草で
さくらが窓の外に身をのりだす。
dialogues.en:
Acting childlike anyway, Sakura stuck out her tongue, then
started heading out the window.
dialogues.text:
Acting childlike anyway, Sakura stuck out her tongue, then
started heading out the window.

dialogues.jp: 「おい、さくら」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Sakura."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Sakura."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Unya?"
dialogues.text: "Unya?"

dialogues.jp: 窓の外の闇の中に、声を投げる。
dialogues.en:
From the darkness outside the window, I could hear Sakura's
reply.
dialogues.text:
From the darkness outside the window, I could hear Sakura's
reply.

dialogues.jp: 「おかえり」
dialogues.en: "Welcome back."
dialogues.text: "Welcome back."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ……えへっ♪　ただいまお兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Ah... Eheh, it's good to be back~"
dialogues.text: "Ah... Eheh, it's good to be back~"

dialogues.jp:
しばらくして窓に寄ると、さくらの姿は消えて
いた。
dialogues.en:
Sakura quickly dropped out the window, her figure
disappearing from sight.
dialogues.text:
Sakura quickly dropped out the window, her figure
disappearing from sight.

dialogues.jp: 手を伸ばして桜の枝に触れてみる。
dialogues.en:
I could still see her hand grasping the branch of the Sakura
tree.
dialogues.text:
I could still see her hand grasping the branch of the Sakura
tree.

dialogues.jp:
それは、今の俺がのったら間違いなく折れてし
まうくらいの、中途半端な太さしかない。
dialogues.en:
Since I was a bit foolhardy in my younger days, the branch
still held the wound of being broken into half.
dialogues.text:
Since I was a bit foolhardy in my younger days, the branch
still held the wound of being broken into half.

dialogues.jp: 「あいつ……ホントに変わってないんだな」
dialogues.en: "That girl... she hasn't changed one bit."
dialogues.text: "That girl... she hasn't changed one bit."

dialogues.jp:
枝をしならせて桜の花をわざと散らして、俺は
窓をしめた。
dialogues.en:
As the sakura continued fluttering right outside my window,
I went over and shut it.
dialogues.text:
As the sakura continued fluttering right outside my window,
I went over and shut it.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくらが不法侵入◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura, the Illegal Intruder◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura, the Illegal Intruder◆

dialogues.jp:
夕飯が終わり、部屋に行くと、さくらが居た。
玄関ではなく、窓から入ってきたらしい。全く、
びっくりさせやがる……。
dialogues.en:
After dinner, when I went to my room, Sakura was there. She
didn't come through the door, but instead from the window.
Really, she scared me half to death...
dialogues.text:
After dinner, when I went to my room, Sakura was there. She
didn't come through the door, but instead from the window.
Really, she scared me half to death...

dialogues.jp:
さくらは、挨拶に来たらしかった。窓は、６年
前から鍵が壊れていて、それで、いつでも出入
りは可能だ。
dialogues.en:
Sakura came to finagle a "welcome back" out of me. She
managed to come in through the window, since it's lock has
been broken for the last 6 years.
dialogues.text:
Sakura came to finagle a "welcome back" out of me. She
managed to come in through the window, since it's lock has
been broken for the last 6 years.

dialogues.jp:
適当にあしらっていると、さくらは、来た時と
同じように、窓から帰っていった。
dialogues.en:
After a bit of reminscience, she went out the same way she
came in.
dialogues.text:
After a bit of reminscience, she went out the same way she
came in.

dialogues.jp:
窓の外の桜の枝は、今の俺が乗ったら、折れて
しまいそうな太さだ。
dialogues.en:
The sakura tree branch outside which she used to climb,
thanks to my clumsiness before, was torn quite badly.
dialogues.text:
The sakura tree branch outside which she used to climb,
thanks to my clumsiness before, was torn quite badly.

dialogues.jp: さくらの奴……ホント、変わってないよな。
dialogues.en: That Sakura... she really hasn't changed one bit.
dialogues.text: That Sakura... she really hasn't changed one bit.
